danger.title: Danger zone
danger.ownersOnly: Only the owner can delete this business.

delete.title: Delete this business
delete.effectLocked: Everyone is locked out at once: staff, admins, screens and kiosks stop working.
delete.effectGuests: Guests can no longer join or see their place in line.
delete.effectPurge: After 7 days all data is erased for good, including visits, guests and files.
delete.export: Export what you need to keep before you delete. After the 7 days nothing can be recovered.
delete.confirmBody: This starts a 7 day countdown. You can cancel until it ends.

pending.title: Deletion is scheduled
pending.body: All data will be erased on {{when}}. Until then you can call it off.

errors.invalid_input: That doesn't match. Type the name exactly as shown.
errors.permission_denied: This business can't be deleted right now. Contact support.
errors.not_found: Only the owner can delete this business.
errors.mfa_required: Confirm with your authenticator code first, then try again.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.intro: People blocked from joining any queue of this business. Removing a block lets them join again at once.
blocks.failed: Couldn't load the blocks. Try again.

requests.title: Data requests
requests.intro: Find a guest by the exact phone number or email they gave, then download everything held about them or erase them.
requests.searchHint: A phone number needs its country code, like +14155550123.
requests.none: No guest holds that phone number or email.

erase.title: Erase {{name}}?
erase.body: Their contact details and profile are deleted for good. Their past visits stay in your statistics without a name or contact. This cannot be undone.
erase.reasonHint: For your records, for example the date of the request.
erase.keep: Keep them on the do-not-message list
erase.keepHint: Recommended. Their phone and email stay blocked from messages so they are never contacted again. Only a hashed record is kept.
erase.done: Erased. {{visits}} visits made anonymous, {{contacts}} contacts deleted.

errors.invalid_input: Enter a full phone number with country code, or an email.
errors.not_found: That guest is no longer available.
errors.mfa_required: Confirm with your authenticator code first, then try again.

privacy.title: Privacy and data retention
privacy.failed: Couldn't load the setting. Try again.
privacy.saved: Saved. Contact details are kept {{count}} day.
privacy.saved_other: Saved. Contact details are kept {{count}} days.
privacy.backups: Encrypted backups can hold older data for up to {{count}} more day after it is removed here.
privacy.backups_other: Encrypted backups can hold older data for up to {{count}} more days after it is removed here.

retention.title: How long we keep guest details
retention.explain: A daily clean-up removes names, phone numbers and emails from visits older than this. Counts and wait times stay in your reports. Guests are told this period when they join or book.
retention.label: Keep contact details for (days)
retention.invalid: Enter a whole number of days in range.
retention.readOnly: Only admins and owners can change this.
retention.impact: After {{count}} day, names, phone numbers and emails are removed from visits. Counts and wait times stay in your reports. Guests are told this period when they join.
retention.impact_other: After {{count}} days, names, phone numbers and emails are removed from visits. Counts and wait times stay in your reports. Guests are told this period when they join.
retention.shorter: Shortening this also removes older visits' details at the next daily clean-up. That can't be undone.
retention.overCap: This platform allows at most {{max}} days.
retention.overrides: Per-form and per-field retention is coming with forms. Until then, this period applies to everything.

runs.title: Recent clean-ups
runs.row: {{at}}: {{visits}} visits and {{appointments}} appointments made anonymous, {{contacts}} contacts deleted.

contacts.title: Privacy officer and breach contact
contacts.explain: The person guests and regulators can contact about privacy, and who we reach if there is a data incident. Sensitive form fields and text messages stay off until this is filled in.
contacts.missing: No privacy officer is recorded yet.
contacts.name: Name
contacts.notAdvice: Information, not advice. Check the rules that apply to you.
contacts.noLinks: Check with your own regulator or adviser.
contacts.showPhone: Also show the phone number to guests
contacts.guestNotice: Guests see the name and email in the privacy notice when they join.
contacts.error: Couldn't save. Check the email and try again.

link.opc: Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada: breach reporting
link.oipcAb: Office of the Information and Privacy Commissioner of Alberta
link.oipcBc: Office of the Information and Privacy Commissioner for BC
link.cai: Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec
link.ftc: US FTC: data breach response guide

contacts.readOnly: Only admins and owners can change the privacy officer.

incidents.title: Incident log
incidents.explain: Keep a record of every privacy or security incident, including ones that turned out harmless. Keep it for at least 24 months.
incidents.error: Couldn't save or load. Try again.
incidents.rateLimited: Too many reports today. Contact support if this is urgent.
incidents.regulator: Regulator or guests told (who and when)
incidents.notAdvice: Information, not advice. Recording an incident here does not notify a regulator or your guests; your privacy officer decides that.

guestNotice.title: Tell your guests
guestNotice.subject: Subject
guestNotice.from: Guests who visited or booked from
guestNotice.hint: Goes by email to guests you hold an email address for (from their contact or the address they typed when joining or booking) who visited or booked in these dates, one message per address. Write only what you want them to read: nothing a guest entered is added. An owner approves it, then sends it. It never sends on its own.

status.draft: Draft. It would reach {{count}} guests. An owner has to approve it.

guestNotice.ownerOnly: Only an owner can approve and send.
guestNotice.sendTitle: Send this message to your guests?
guestNotice.sendBody: It goes by email to {{count}} guests and can't be recalled.
guestNotice.capped: That is more than can be sent today. Narrow the dates, or contact support.
guestNotice.error: Couldn't save or send. Try again.
